info.name: Card Show Scanner - TCGTracking Research Diagnostics
info.description: Read-only Direct Research diagnostics. Import the companion environment, enter local shipper ID/API key values, select that environment, then Run collection once in order. Defaults target Charmander SV Promo 044, TCGplayer product 512035, English Holofoil PSA 9. Request 01 resolves the exact set ID automatically from the Research index. Request 02 captures the independent public catalog set list. Request 03 verifies the exact product, variant and grader/grade and writes tcgt_research_summary. Edit collection variables to test another card. Use the Postman desktop app or Desktop Agent on an allowlisted public network IP. No PSA certificate lookup is performed. No credentials are included in these files or the generated summary; do not share populated environments or request headers.

item.name: 03 - Exact card, printing and grade Research

request.description: Uses the group ID resolved by request 01. Sends a fresh unconditional request, validates response identity and checks exact product/variant/grader/grade. Read tcgt_research_summary in collection variables or the Postman Console. When sending this request individually, the Visualize tab also displays the summary. Expected coverage failures appear as failed tests, independently of HTTP/authentication success.
